description: Live-probe a mail server over SMTP: connects to port 25 (or a given port), reads the banner, issues EHLO and lists advertised capabilities (STARTTLS, AUTH mechanisms, SIZE, 8BITMIME, PIPELINING), then upgrades via STARTTLS when offered and reports the TLS protocol and certificate (issuer, expiry). The server-side complement to email_deliverability_check (which reads DNS records only and never connects). No mail is sent and no relay attempt is made.

host.description: Mail server hostname, e.g. mail.example.com — or a bare domain, in which case its lowest-priority-number MX host is probed

name: smtp_server_check
